//: Lighthouse CI config for the docs site (docs-theming-and-versioning Req 4.4, 4.5).
Self-contained: collect.startServerCommand builds nothing itself — the docs app is
built by the CI step BEFORE LHCI runs (bun run build --filter=@rgss/docs) — and then
`next start -p 3003` serves the production build locally; collect.url points every
audited route at that local server so the gate runs without a live deploy.
The route list covers the Req 4.4/4.5 surface: the docs landing page plus one
representative content page per top-level documentation section (the folders +
root pages under content/docs), and one legacy-version page (/docs/v2) so the
versioned output is audited too. Each URL is reported separately by Lighthouse CI,
so a sub-threshold score on ANY audited route fails the corresponding
`categories:*` assertion and blocks merge, naming the offending URL.
best-practices >= 0.95. These are the docs gate and are independent of the web
app's lighthouserc.json (perf >= 0.9) — that config is intentionally unchanged.
